info.title: AI Café — PayPal Commerce Agent API
info.description: Agentic-commerce API for the PayPal AI Hackathon. A natural-language AI agent prepares a shopping cart, but the **server owns all prices** and a **human authorizes every PayPal payment** — the agent never touches money. A read-only PayPal Ops Copilot lets a merchant audit activity. This spec powers SDK generation (APIMatic) and the Postman collection.

tags.name: MCP (Agentic Commerce)
tags.description: Model Context Protocol server: lets any external AI agent shop at AI Café and start a PayPal checkout that only a human can approve

tags.name: Refunds

bearerAuth.description: Server-issued session token (from POST /api/sessions), sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

violations.description: Any policy violations that would be reported.

suggestion.description: suggested next step for the shopper (field).

sessionToken.description: Returned exactly once; present as Bearer token.

preparedCart.description: The validated, server-priced cart prepared by the agent; null when none was prepared.

items.description: The validated cart lines with authoritative pricing.

requiresExplicitApproval.description: True when human approval is required.

retrySuggested.description: True when an alternative cart is suggested.

checkoutReady.description: whether the cart is ready for checkout (field).

suggestion.description: Rule-based mode only: a manual add-anyway offer. Not a prepared cart; authorises nothing.

messageCount.description: number of messages in the conversation (field).

mode.description: "ai" when an LLM answered; "rule-based" when every AI provider was exhausted and the clearly-labelled non-AI Quick Planner answered. Rule-based carts are attributed to HUMAN, never AI_AGENT.

provider.description: Which provider answered (e.g. groq, gemini) or "rule-based" for the non-AI planner. Names only. Also sent as the X-AI-Provider header.

model.description: Model id that produced the final answer; null for the rule-based planner.

modelCalls.description: Model calls made for this turn (0 for the rule-based planner). A turn is bounded by 6 rounds, 12 executed tool calls and 40 s; past a ceiling the next call is made without tools.

fallback.description: true when an earlier provider/model failed first, the provider changed within the turn, or the rule-based planner answered.

revenueMinor.description: Gross captured amount of PAID orders (before refunds).

refundedMinor.description: Sum of merchant-approved refunds on paid orders (never more than captured).

netRevenueMinor.description: revenueMinor minus refundedMinor; what the merchant keeps.

suggestion.description: suggested next step for the shopper (field).

violations.description: Any policy violations that would be reported.

violatedRules.description: Identifiers of rules that were violated for this decision.

policySnapshot.description: Snapshot of the policy that was in effect, captured at decision time.

dailySpendLimitMinor.description: Daily spend cap in minor units.

confirmationThresholdMinor.description: Above this amount, explicit human approval is required (minor units).

requiresKey.description: whether a provider key is required (field).

id.description: Echo of the request id (string or integer in JSON-RPC; shown as string here)

lastError.description: Set when PayPal could not process an approval; the request stays PROPOSED and can be retried safely.

amountMinor.description: Optional partial refund; omit for the full remaining amount.

mandate.description: Canonical content that was signed (version aicafe.cart-mandate/1).

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature over the stable-stringified mandate

kid.description: Key id: the active key or a configured previous public key

canonicalization.description: UTF-8 JSON, object keys sorted, no whitespace (fast-json-stable-stringify 2.x). Not RFC 8785.

PolicyDecision.description: The authoritative policy decision for a cart.

RefundStatus.description: Lifecycle state of a refund request.

MatchMode.description: How multiple search terms are combined.

Violation.description: A single policy violation found when evaluating a cart.

url.description: https URL of the retailer page. Outbound link only.

enabled.description: False when CHANNEL3_API_KEY is not configured.

TransactionPassport.description: Read-only, server-derived explanation of one prepared cart. Not a payment record, never stored or signed; payment authority is always the shopper.

lineTotalMinor.description: line total in minor currency units (field).

remainingMinor.description: Negative when the cart is over the limit.

post.description: Tools: `search_menu`, `prepare_cart`, `check_policy`, `start_checkout`, `get_order_status`. There is deliberately NO capture/pay/refund tool: `start_checkout` returns a PayPal sandbox approval URL that a human must approve. Call `initialize` first and send the returned `Mcp-Session-Id` header on every later request. A GET on this path returns 405 (the optional SSE stream is not offered).

requestBody.description: An MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 request (initialize, tools/list, or tools/call).

parameters.name: Mcp-Session-Id
parameters.description: Session header returned by MCP initialize; required for tools/call.

post.summary: Propose a refund moves no money

requestBody.description: Details of the refund request to propose. Proposing moves no money.

409.description: Order not paid, fully refunded, or already has an open request

post.summary: Approve and issue the refund via PayPal sandbox
post.description: The only endpoint that calls PayPal's refund API. Uses a stable PayPal-Request-Id (`aicafe-refund-<id>`), but does not rely on its unverified retention window alone: an ambiguous outcome must be reconciled against the PayPal refund or capture before another request.

202.description: PayPal returned a non-final status; the request remains PROCESSING and cannot be retried until reconciled

409.description: Not in PROPOSED state or PayPal refund status is indeterminate

502.description: PayPal returned a definitive failure or the refund outcome is unknown; request remains PROPOSED and is reconciled before retry

get.summary: Signed Cart Mandate for one of your orders
get.description: Ed25519-signed, deterministic record of what the shopper was asked to approve: items, server prices, total, origin (HUMAN / AI_AGENT) and the constraints (the agent may not authorize payment; payment authority is the buyer's approval at PayPal). Derived from the stored order, so it survives restarts when MANDATE_SIGNING_KEY is configured. Another session's order is a 404.

503.description: Mandate key configuration is invalid (reported, never a 500)

post.summary: Verify a Cart Mandate no session needed
post.description: Checks the key id, the Ed25519 signature, the expiry window and, when the order is still known, that the mandate still matches it. Expiry is informational: a genuine but expired mandate stays valid.

requestBody.description: The signed Cart Mandate to verify against the published signing key.

get.description: Single source of truth for AI agents: merchant, endpoints, MCP tool names (derived from the real MCP registry), guardrails (agentCanPay/Capture/Refund = false), policy limits, Cart Mandate verification info and disclaimers. Custom aicafe.* format; not an official PayPal Agent Ready, Store Sync or AP2 integration. URLs come from PUBLIC_BASE_URL (required in production); public cache only when it is configured.

get.description: Custom schema.org-style JSON-LD ItemList of Product/Offer entries with server catalog prices (price decimal string, additionalProperty priceMinor/dietary). Not an official PayPal Store Sync feed. Read-only, ETag-revalidatable.

503.description: Public base URL is not configured (production without PUBLIC_BASE_URL) or is unusable

post.description: Read-only product discovery through Channel3. The query is built on the server from the catalog category of the cart items; no client text is forwarded. Results are outbound retailer links: not part of the PayPal cart, not covered by the spending allowance, never paid through this API. Returns enabled=false when no Channel3 key is configured.
